column1: # T10d proposals: MAIN <-> IFDSP (RT685) register link over SCI4. address<TAB>name<TAB>plate comment

column3: Boot: P71=1, 100 ms, send "i DB00\r", 2 ms, shadows=0xFFFF, read reg0 (version -> 0x1444) and reg1 (bit0 ready); failure -> 0x20B36=2
main_loop task: finish pending r/w, DSP-update bridge, 20 ms status poll (regs 1-4), then setter chain (max one frame per pass)
Blocking read/write of any DSP register (used by CAT SPD); write does not update the shadow
Build "rAAAACC\r" / "wAAAADDDDCC\r" from 0x1B6DE/0x1B6E0 into 0x1A5E, send on SCI4, start 6 ms reply timer 3, set busy flag 0x1C5F/0x1C5E
Poll SCI4 reply: 'r'+4hex+2hex sum (read) or 0x06 (write ACK) -> 1; timer 3 expiry clears busy flags
Checks the 2 hex checksum chars after n reply chars
Store 0x1B6E0 into the shadow of register 0x1B6DE (table 0x1B634..0x1B6DD); regs 1-4 also run their status filters
DSP firmware update: P71=0/P72=1 (ISP boot), ping 5A A6, then forward MCUBoot frames DISPLAY(SCI1) <-> DSP(SCI4) until DISPLAY sends F1 82; never returns to normal mode
Sets 0x1C63=1 (DISPLAY link sub-command 2) so dsp_link_poll enters dsp_isp_bridge
SCI4 per-byte callback: sets expected length from first byte (06/? ->1, r ->7, 5A xx -> MCUBoot packet length); drops other lead bytes
Returns the SCI4 receive buffer (0xA0AB) [decompiler lost the return value]
Copies the 6-char "V01-01" DSP version text to 0x1444 (read by ver_dsp / VE3)
Per-audio-route constants for regs 8, 9, 10, 0x0D/0x0E, 0x20 and EQ enable 0x25/0x28/0x2B; sets 0x20B49
Read reg 1 (bit0 ready, bit4 VOX, bit6 tone decode, high byte FM noise)
reg1: bit6 debounced over 5 polls -> 0x1C61; in RX (0x20B18==8) high byte averaged over 2 -> 0x1C60
reg4: most frequent of last 8 samples -> 0x1B6E4 (100 if none repeats)

column1: # --- setters (one per register; send only when the computed value differs from the shadow)

column3: reg 6: 3 LSB/DATA-L/RTTY-L, 2 USB/DATA-U/RTTY-U/PSK, 1 CW-L, 0 CW-U, 8 AM, 9 FM
reg 0x0D: 0xF000 in CW TX route, else 0
reg 0x0E: 0xF000 in CW TX route, else 0
reg 0x20: modulation gain curve value (MIC/USB/REAR gain)
reg 0x22: anti-VOX vs AF gain, 0xFF when PF5 low
regs 0x25/0x28/0x2B: parametric mic EQ band frequency | 0x1000 enable
regs 0x26/0x29/0x2C: parametric mic EQ band level (signed)
regs 0x27/0x2A/0x2D: parametric mic EQ band width
reg 0x35: TX tone index+1 | 0x1000 (FM, tone on)
reg 0x45: APF centre (pitch + APF offset) | width<<12 when APF on
regs 0x48/0x4B/0x4E: AF tone band frequency 200/400/1200 Hz | 0x1000

regs 0x4A/0x4D/0x50: Q of the three AF tone (BASS/MIDDLE/TREBLE) peaking bands, constant 2/1/1 in every mode [fact: HiFi4 rx_eq_band_update 0x220790 uses the third reg of each triple as Q, 0 -> 0.5 else clamped 1..10]; was dsp_set_tone_type
reg 0x52: manual notch freq | width<<12 (AM only)
reg 0x53: RX tone index+1 | 0x1000 (FM, tone on); sets 0x20B72
reg 0x62 AGC on, reg 0x66 AGC delay (20n+20 ms; scan 200/40/4)
reg 0x67: RF gain curve (0xFF when knob is SQL)
reg 0x4026: DNR table by level (all zero)

column1: # --- shared helpers (may duplicate other T10 sub-tasks; parent dedups)

column3: Soft timer id (0..0x4A): count = ms*10 ticks, clears expired flag 0x11FED[id]
Soft-timer tick (100 us [inference]): advances 75 timers and 2 blink timers
Returns 0..14: CW/RTTY RX 0, record 1/3, spot 2, playback 4/5, CW/RTTY TX 6/7, voice RX 8 (9-12 variants), voice TX 13, playback TX 14
Current modulation gain: MIC GAIN or per-mode USB/REAR MOD GAIN by MOD SOURCE
P71 (PODR 0x8C027 bit1): 0 holds the RT685 in reset [inference]
P72 (PODR 0x8C027 bit2): 1 selects RT685 serial ISP boot [inference]
